summary: amazon.aws deprecated Python 3.9 support, to be removed in a release after 2027-04-01 following the AWS SDK for Python ending 3.9 support in April 2026.
questions: Can I keep running amazon.aws modules on Python 3.9?
Why am I seeing a Python 3.9 deprecation in amazon.aws?

answer_card.title: amazon.aws: Python 3.9 deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: Python 3.9 support in **amazon.aws** is deprecated and will be removed in a release **after 2027-04-01**, because boto3/botocore ended Python 3.9 support in April 2026. Plan to move the Python on your control node/execution environment to 3.10 or newer.
